Title: Verify that the Customer Name accepts a name containing a space between words
Steps to Reproduce:
1) Enter "Anita John" in the Customer Name Field 
2) Press TAB and move to next Field
Test Data: Anita John
Expected Result: The system accepts the valid details entered in the fields and displays the appropriate success message or confirmation prompt.
Actual Result: An error message "Numbers are not allowed" is shown

Actual Result: Entered a leading space followed by "Anita" in the Customer Name field and pressed TAB. An error message "Numbers are not allowed" is shown.

Title: Verify that the Address field does not accept tab/whitespace-only input

2) Press TAB and move to next Field

Expected Result: Since Address is a required field, whitespace-only input must not be accepted. On pressing TAB, the field should either reject the spaces (trim them and keep the field empty), or display an error message such as “Address cannot be empty” / “Address is required”, and prevent the value being treated as valid.
Actual Result: Entered only spaces in the Address field and pressed TAB. No error message was displayed. Focus moved to the next field.
